tagline: Up the Androscoggin into moose country, and over the notch.
intro: North of Gorham, NH 16 follows the Androscoggin up through Berlin, the city that trees built, and on to the Pontook Reservoir. Above the dam the road runs into the 13 Mile Woods beside the river, with the Mahoosuc Range behind. At Errol, where the Androscoggin begins, the byway turns west on NH 26 and climbs to Dixville Notch, then comes down to Colebrook and US 3 north toward Pittsburg.
From Pontook through the notch is the likeliest stretch for moose, which turn up at the roadside in low, swampy ground.

moments.title: Pontook Reservoir
moments.text: A hydroelectric pond on the Androscoggin, with class III rapids below the dam, the hardest on the river and a favorite with paddlers.

moments.title: Dixville Notch State Park
moments.text: NH 26 squeezes through a short, steep-walled gorge on the line between the Androscoggin and Connecticut watersheds, with waterfalls on two brooks and trails up to Table Rock.

moments.title: Dixville Notch
moments.text: A village of four people at about 1,800 feet, whose handful of voters meet at midnight in the ballroom of The Balsams and report first in the New Hampshire primary.

practical: Visit NH warns that this is moose country and asks drivers to take care, especially at night, dusk and dawn.
